comments.author: Nekos
comments.body:
There's a weather phenomenon here.Yellow Sand.
You have to have recognition 7. Appear at noon and sunny.
The location is at the upturned booulder at the middle, go to the right path. Stay at the vertex of the curve where you have to go to the right.
